title: Finding — User feedback (model vs your truth)

options.content:
**Your own emotion labels vs what the 3 models predicted at that moment.** Each row = one time you tapped the feedback button and picked a quadrant (Bucuros/Calm/Trist/Stresat). The server paired it with the live PPG and what WESAD/EEVR/CASE said.

- **quadrant_code**: 1=Calm · 2=Trist · 3=Bucuros · 4=Stresat. Positive valence = Bucuros/Calm (codes 1,3).
- **wesad_p / eevr_p / case_p**: each model's P(positive valence). >0.5 = it bet 'pleasant'.
- **arousal_z**: your measured arousal at that moment (the axis that WORKS).

Watch whether any model's p tracks your actual pleasant/unpleasant labels. The 33 PPG features per label are banked in `data/feedback_labels.jsonl`. Run `train/feedback_validate.py` for the accuracy numbers. At ~20-30 varied labels, Phase B tests a personal model.

panels.title: Your labels vs the models (latest first)

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, CASE quadrant_code WHEN 1 THEN 'Calm' WHEN 2 THEN 'Trist' WHEN 3 THEN 'Bucuros' WHEN 4 THEN 'Stresat' ELSE '?' END AS "YOUR label", round(arousal_z,2) AS "arousal_z", round(wesad_p,2) AS "WESAD p", round(eevr_p,2) AS "EEVR p", round(case_p,2) AS "CASE p" FROM biofizic_legacy_feedback WHERE $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: Labels collected per quadrant (need variety for Phase B)

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE quadrant_code WHEN 1 THEN 'Calm' WHEN 2 THEN 'Trist' WHEN 3 THEN 'Bucuros' WHEN 4 THEN 'Stresat' ELSE '?' END AS quadrant, count(*) AS n FROM biofizic_legacy_feedback WHERE $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY quadrant_code ORDER BY quadrant_code
SELECT count(*) AS labels FROM biofizic_legacy_feedback WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
